notes.title: Updated February 15th
notes.notes:
In this update  we have:-

1. Moved English Cup 1st and 2nd replays to dates that don’t clash with league matches.
2. Improved appearance of the formation selection screen.
3. Improved appearance of the match intro screen.
4. Added club shields to upcoming fixtures section of the home screen.
5. Added squad roles info to the club performance screen.
6. Fixed issue where players outside of team could be given free-kick taker roles etc.
7.  Plus we have made  other minor changes.

We hope that you are enjoying the game.

notes.title: Update 8th January
notes.notes:
Hi 

Today we have updated the game, the main features of the update are:-

1. On the formation screen it is now possible to rearrange the players by selecting the shirts.
2. Right clicking on a shirt on the formation screen will now display his profile.
3. Substitutes screen layout improved.
4. Match intro screen layout improved.
5. Fixed an issue where language panel background may be wrongly used when starting new game.
6. Edit mode, fixed issue with player position.
